planted.why: Rule 4 keeps a dependency only when a queued record whose queuedAt is inside the last 30 days names it. A task queued earlier can still be queued: planStarts holds one after MAX_LAUNCH_ATTEMPTS refused launches, and one whose dependency awaits a verdict stays pending. Its dependency is then archived, and dependencyState reads the missing record as blocked with 'no ledger record', so the task can never start. The right population is every queued record, whatever its age.
